verdict.rationale: Klaviyo has a dedicated webhooks documentation page with an endpoint to "Get all webhooks in an account," which implies webhook subscriptions can be managed through the API. That single thin mention is the only evidence, so subscribing to events is implied rather than clearly documented. Missing for 10: documented create/subscribe endpoint, list of subscribable event topics, payload/signature verification and retry details, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
